_comment: D5 v3 corroboration gate — ON ARM.  One functional key over _corrob_off.json:
network.carry_invariant_innov_corroborate.  Everything else, including the Card-G
arming that supplies the raw MW/GF verdicts, is inherited unchanged, so the arms are
a true one-treatment pair.
WHAT IT DOES.  A chord that trips the D5 k*sigma0 test is re-tapped UNLESS the raw
observables positively measured its arc as continuous.  Tri-state and fail-safe:
stepped => re-tap; measured-and-flat => SUPPRESS; no evidence => re-tap.  The coarse
MW/LLI/IF-TD layer is untouched, so standing invariant #1's slip response is narrowed,
never removed.  Backstop left at the default 0 (pure corroboration) because
corroboration was measured to FALL with innovation size (2.1% below 25 sigma, 0.0% at
100-200, 1.2% above 200) — a magnitude backstop would re-admit exactly the population
with the least evidence of being a real slip.
EXPECTED.  runs/rawstep_smoke measured 97.0% of D5 flags as raw_stepped=0, so the
suppression rate should land near that.  PRIMARY read is the run-end D5 v3 line
(suppressed / tripped) and then dd_sigma_cyc: if the re-tap loop is what pins the DD
ambiguity variance at ~3.9 cyc, suppressing ~97% of unjustified re-taps should let it
start falling.  10 epochs cannot show convergence — this arm proves the MECHANISM
fires and is byte-safe; the sigma-vs-time verdict needs a >=3 h run.
WATCH: a run-end WARN saying the gate suppressed NOTHING means the flat set never
reached the driver (no slip-QC consumer computed the raw observables) — inert, not
permissive.  That warn is the invariant-#4 tripwire for this feature.
